# Project Atlas Operating Model

**Version:** 0.1.8-beta

Project Atlas is the living model of the project.

> **Decided → Exists → Evidence → Gap → Next**

## Atlas

Use stable domains (Product, UX, Design, Architecture, Engineering, Security & Privacy, Quality, Operations, Economics, Campaigns) with dynamic project-specific subsections.

Objects, not pages, are primary. Meaningful objects carry lifecycle state, provenance, evidence, confidence/freshness, dependencies and next action.

Default lifecycle:

`PROPOSED → REVIEWED → CANONICAL → IMPLEMENTED → VERIFIED`

Side states:

`BLOCKED | NEEDS_REVIEW | STALE | SUPERSEDED | REJECTED | DEFERRED`

When intent and observed reality disagree, create a Gap Object. Do not silently rewrite either side.

## Governance

Many sources may propose; governed flows promote. Proposal is not canon. Finding is not decision. Evidence is not authority.

Human edits are first-class governed decisions with provenance and downstream review effects.

## Sources

Repository owns durable project brain/product artifacts. SpecLoops service owns orchestration/index/view state. GitHub owns code reality. Runtime/deployment/billing systems own their facts. Specialists own only their finding records.

## Campaign Themes

Campaign Themes are packaged operating playbooks. One primary campaign controls the main next-action journey; secondary campaigns are advisory unless they raise a governed blocker.

Initial themes: Session Zero/MVP, Refactor & Modernize, Code & Architecture Review.

Campaigns define explicit exit criteria and preserve unresolved/deferred work when transitioning.

## Specialists

Persistent bounded roles: Implementer, Auditor, Operations, Verifier, Architect.

Flow:

`OBSERVE → PROPOSE → ATTACH EVIDENCE → CLASSIFY → ESCALATE IF NEEDED → GOVERNED PROMOTION`

Findings: INFORMATIONAL | ATTENTION | BLOCKER | DECISION_REQUIRED.

Run specialists on material events and predictable schedules. Preserve evidence-backed disagreements.

## Briefing

Default human/executive consumption is one synthesized Project Briefing generated from Atlas state. Show what changed, what matters, blockers, decisions required, risks, next actions and links to evidence. Do not make the human coordinate separate specialist reports.

## Reconstruction

Existing projects: Reality Before Reconstruction. Inspect reality first, build provisional Atlas, mark OBSERVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN, then ask only consequential unresolved questions.

Net-new projects: Session Zero progressively fills Atlas until buildable. Do not require exhaustive upfront intake.
